name: University of Lucerne
summary: Public university in Lucerne; its bachelor's are taught in German, and you need a German C1 certificate by the time you start.

ib.text: 32/42, six subjects, three HL incl. maths or a science (2026/27); Psychology, ESS, Global Politics and the arts don't count. German C1 certificate by the programme start, not with the application.

dates.label: Registration for the autumn semester opens (same date every year)
Regular application deadline (same date every year)
Late applications close if you need no visa, CHF 150 surcharge (same date every year)
Late applications close if you need a visa (same date every year)

notes: Only some master's programmes are taught entirely in English; every bachelor's needs German.
The German certificate can follow your application, but you must have it by the start of the programme.
